cost_accounting: Rho includes curve setup, point parsing and subgroup validation, jump-table setup, all walks, table queries/inserts, collision checks and scalar verification in one fresh process. Record wall, child user/system CPU, peak RSS, operations. Compact IC comparator includes its full cold rank-training process plus its cold point batch, including duplicated setup; the 512-relation training receipt is a conservative overcharge relative to first full rank at relation 461. Do not call a stage result an attack speedup.
decision_rule: For each size, declare a measured cold no-crossover on this fixed eight-point stream only if all three point-only rho runs recover and independently verify every scalar and all three rho process wall times are below the archived fully charged compact-IC two-process wall. Otherwise inconclusive. This does not establish n131 transfer or general amortized crossover.
hypothesis: Cold rho will remain cheaper than the archived compact-orbit full-rank training plus eight point-only recovery queries at both L=1 and L=8.
limits: The compact IC archive and these rho runs are same host but not contemporaneous paired blocks; host load is recorded. Wall comparisons are sensitivity evidence and CPU/operation counts are secondary. No claim of optimized rho optimality.
question: What is the cold same-point-stream signed-Frobenius batched-rho cost for the eight public n53 point-only compact-IC targets, and for the first target alone?
stopping_rule: One cold process for each scheduled seed and prefix. Internal per-target step cap unchanged from the v3 producer. External timeout 180 seconds per process; preserve timeouts, panics, and incomplete outputs without replacing a seed.
validation: Rho child receives only public point coordinates, never validation scalars. After each child exits, independently compute [recovered]G for every row in Python and compare to Q, then compare to the validator labels from PR #735 separately; reject any row mismatch, missing row, wrong order, or nonzero exit.
